daily.brief: 這段時間289則帖文來自75個帳號，看好118對看淡49，多頭聲音仍然明顯較多。共同看好最齊的是$SPY和$QQQ，特朗普宣佈今天不會攻擊伊朗帶動期貨上漲，也有人強調忽略戰爭頭條、專注盈利與技術強度。共同看淡較集中在新雲端的$CRWV，擔心債務結構與整合失敗。分歧最大在$SPCX、$TSLA和$NVDA，最多人講仍是這些代號。
daily.full:
共識

共同看好最齊的是$SPY（2好0淡，21次提及）和$QQQ（2好0淡，18次）。@MarkNewtonCMT表示忽略戰爭頭條是划算的：戰爭持續了今年大部分時間，標普仍上漲13.5%，應專注盈利、技術強度以及推動這波走勢的因素，中期選舉前會是波動（原帖）。@KobeissiLetter報導美國股市期貨開盤上漲，因特朗普總統宣佈今天不會攻擊伊朗，標普500 +0.5%，納斯達克100 +0.7%（原帖）。@Mr_Derivatives則看$QQQ守住藍色框，不意外會去填補$725.20缺口，還有迷你RSI看多背離（原帖）。

記憶體相關也有共同看好：$MU 2好0淡，13次提及。@amitisinvesting指出Elon可能討厭新雲端但似乎喜愛記憶體，引用「機器人RAM需求將超過地球上其他一切」，提及$MU $SNDK $SKHY（原帖）。@petenajarian轉發$MU 10月26日到期、行使價900美元的認購期權以13美元平倉，不到15分鐘上漲152%（原帖）。$INTC和$SKHY也有類似聲音，談量子軟件收購與南韓市場估值。

共同看淡

共同看淡最集中的是$CRWV（0好6淡，13次提及）。@carlquintanilla引用關於AI泡沫可能因新雲端及高風險AI債務違約而作為信貸事件爆發，導致估值下降與收縮的說法（原帖）。@howardlindzon指新雲端公司的財務結構複雜，評級機構已無法可靠追蹤數據中心SPV與融資結構，債務與未來負債可能遠超10Q披露（原帖）。@WallStJesus則報導新雲端公司股價盤前下跌，Elon Musk表示這些公司將面臨重大整合與失敗，$NBIS下跌4.5%，$CRWV下跌4.4%（原帖）。

分歧

$SPCX 3好2淡，25次提及。@TheTranscript_報導執行長稱AI運算回本期可能在2027年縮短至六個月，受供應收緊和租金價格上漲支持，不認為會有需求問題（原帖）。@aleabitoreddit則談又有400億美元進入AI基礎設施泡沫，Elon表示$SPCX融資主要用於2027年上半年$NVDA GPU採購，間接增加記憶體及網絡需求（原帖）。但有聲音擔心電力與建設風險。

$TSLA 3好2淡，23次提及。@SawyerMerritt轉述Canaccord Genuity分析師稱對Tesla第三季業績電話會議持負面看法的人完全錯誤，這是近年來最直言不諱的看多電話會議之一，EV訂單積壓達4（原帖）。@RedDogT3則說TSLA不同，清除了一個宏觀模式，現在部分獲利（原帖）。

$NVDA 2好1淡，25次提及。@Beth_Kindig引用Lam Research關於AI代幣需求：過去18個月平均每週代幣使用量約上升250倍（原帖）。但@michaeljburry同意Ken Griffin關於GPU是商品的看空觀點，運行邊際成本低，一旦產能過剩價格就會自由落體，類似2000年光纖建設後電信業的情況（原帖）。

其他值得留意

數據範圍是這段時間289則帖文（272原創、17轉發）、75個帳號，看好118對看淡49，清晰觀點帳號46個。最多人講是$SPCX（25次）、$NVDA（25次）和$TSLA（23次）。以上只整理公開帖文觀點，非投資建議。

daily.brief: In this window 289 posts from 75 accounts show 118 bullish views versus 49 bearish, with bulls still louder. Strongest joint bullish are $SPY and $QQQ, as Trump announced no attack on Iran today lifting futures, with some emphasizing ignore war headlines and focus on earnings and technical strength. Joint bearish concentrates on $CRWV over new-cloud debt and integration risks. Biggest splits on $SPCX, $TSLA and $NVDA, most mentions still these names.
daily.full:
Consensus

Strongest joint bullish are $SPY (2 bulls 0 bears, 21 mentions) and $QQQ (2 bulls 0 bears, 18 mentions). @MarkNewtonCMT said ignoring war headlines has paid off: war has continued most of the year yet the S&P is up 13.5%. Focus on earnings, technical strength and what is driving this move; volatility before midterms (post). @KobeissiLetter reported US stock futures opened higher after President Trump announced no attack on Iran today, S&P 500 +0.5%, Nasdaq 100 +0.7% (post). @Mr_Derivatives noted $QQQ holding the blue box, not surprising if it fills the $725.20 gap, plus mini RSI bullish divergence (post).

Memory names also joint bullish: $MU 2 bulls 0 bears, 13 mentions. @amitisinvesting pointed out Elon may hate new clouds but seems to love memory, citing robot RAM demand will exceed everything else on Earth, mentioning $MU $SNDK $SKHY (post). @petenajarian shared a $MU Oct 26 900 call closed at $13, up 152% in under 15 minutes (post). $INTC and $SKHY also have similar voices on quantum software deals and Korean market valuations.

Joint Bearish

Most concentrated joint bearish is $CRWV (0 bulls 6 bears, 13 mentions). @carlquintanilla cited views that the AI bubble may burst as a credit event from new-cloud and high-risk AI debt defaults, leading to valuation compression (post). @howardlindzon noted new-cloud financial structures are complex; rating agencies can no longer reliably track data-center SPVs and financing, with debt and future liabilities possibly far exceeding 10Q disclosures (post). @WallStJesus reported new-cloud stocks pre-market lower; Elon Musk said these companies will face major consolidation and failures, $CRWV down 4.4% (post).

Splits

$SPCX 3 bulls 2 bears, 25 mentions. @TheTranscript_ reported the CEO saying AI compute payback period could shorten to six months in 2027, supported by tightening supply and rising rental prices, no demand issues expected (post). @aleabitoreddit talked about another $40B into the AI infrastructure bubble; Elon said $SPCX financing mainly for H1 2027 $NVDA GPU purchases, indirectly boosting memory and networking demand (post). Some worry about power and construction risks.

$TSLA 3 bulls 2 bears, 23 mentions. @SawyerMerritt relayed Canaccord Genuity analyst saying those negative on Tesla's Q3 call were completely wrong; it was one of the most outright bullish calls in years, with EV order backlog of 4 (post). @RedDogT3 said TSLA is different, cleared a macro pattern, taking some profits now (post).

$NVDA 2 bulls 1 bear, 25 mentions. @Beth_Kindig cited Lam Research on AI token demand: average weekly token usage up ~250x over the past 18 months (post). But @michaeljburry agreed with Ken Griffin that GPUs are a commodity; low marginal cost of running them means prices free-fall once capacity overshoots, similar to telecom after the 2000 fiber buildout (post).

Other Notes

Data range is 289 posts (272 originals, 17 reposts) from 75 accounts, 118 bullish vs 49 bearish views, 46 accounts with clear views. Most mentioned are $SPCX (25), $NVDA (25) and $TSLA (23). Above only organizes public post views, not investment advice.
